name: Sanicball
description:
Sanicball is a fast, physics-defying multiplayer arcade racing game satirizing the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise. Players take control of spherical characters navigating wildly twisting tracks at breakneck velocities.

Features:
- High-velocity racing mechanics with dramatic ramps, loop-the-loops, and air control
- Multiple playable parody characters each with distinct speed and handling attributes
- Online multiplayer racing lobbies and local split-screen multiplayer support
- Energetic soundtrack featuring meme-inspired audio tracks
- Built-in track selection with varying difficulty levels and terrain traps
